brand.because: Owner decision (Paul Kinlan, 2026-10-13): 'we probably need both'. The booking archetype retains both brands: 'Evening Class Studio' serves as the primary brand matching the visual reference boards and headings, while 'Learning Hub' is retained as the companion/variant brand from the demo implementation. Both brands are valid and preserved in the archetype.
